As a Christian, I believe in love and respect, so I wouldn’t say anything toxic. However, if you're feeling insecure, you might jokingly say, *"Don’t forget who’s waiting at home—God’s watching, and so am I!"* But always communicate with kindness and trust. 😊

*(Note: This is a lighthearted response, not an endorsement of toxic behavior.)*
